package_info.why_malicious: The affected Struts2 versions contain a critical deserialization vulnerability in the REST plugin's XML handling, allowing attackers to submit crafted XML payloads that result in remote code execution (RCE) on the server. This enables attackers to take full control of vulnerable systems.

execution_context.file_location: Struts2 REST plugin (XML deserialization via XStream)

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At runtime, the server receives a crafted XML payload containing a serialized java.lang.ProcessBuilder object, which is deserialized by XStream, resulting in arbitrary command execution on the server.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Deserializing untrusted XML input directly into Java objects allows attackers to instantiate arbitrary classes and execute system commands.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Normal behavior expects XML input to be parsed as data, not as executable code or objects with side effects.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Legitimate use would involve deserializing trusted, validated XML from known sources, not arbitrary user input.
key_indicators: Use of XStream without type restrictions
Presence of java.lang.ProcessBuilder or similar classes in XML payload

attack_chain.action: Attacker sends a crafted XML payload to a Struts2 REST endpoint.
attack_chain.leads_to: XML is deserialized by XStream, instantiating attacker-controlled Java objects.

attack_chain.action: Deserialization triggers execution of arbitrary system commands on the server.
attack_chain.leads_to: Attacker gains remote code execution and control over the server.

behavioral_signatures: Deserialization of untrusted XML input via XStream
Unexpected instantiation of java.lang.ProcessBuilder or similar classes from XML
Execution of system commands triggered by HTTP POST/PUT requests to REST endpoints
file_indicators: XStream library usage in application code
network_indicators: Unusual HTTP POST/PUT requests with large or complex XML payloads to REST endpoints
Outbound connections initiated by the server following suspicious XML requests
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for HTTP requests containing suspicious XML payloads to Struts2 REST endpoints, especially those referencing java.lang.ProcessBuilder or other sensitive classes. Audit application logs for unexpected command execution or errors during XML deserialization. Use application firewalls or runtime instrumentation to block or alert on deserialization of untrusted data.
